content_data.project_title: North American Automotive UX Consulting Pilot Program
content_data.project_description: Proposal for a pilot program to implement user-experience driven consulting services for key automotive clients across North America, focusing on measurable financial impact.
content_data.timeline: Initial phase over 9 months, with potential for extension based on performance metrics.
content_data.project_lead: Dr. Anya Sharma, Senior Financial Analyst
objectives: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to quantitatively track the ROI of UX improvements for pilot clients.
deliverables: Quarterly financial performance reviews for the pilot program.
compliance_requirements: Review of intellectual property rights for any jointly developed solutions or methodologies.
